name: (04) Thaumaturgy (Path of Conjuring) — 2 Intermediate — Magic of the Smith

system.description:
Complex objects of mixed materials and moving parts now fall within the conjurer's craft, wrought whole and lasting from nothing.

As long as you have a working familiarity with the object, you may create a copy of it, whole and permanent: knives, guns, clothes, medicines and the like. Creation costs five Blood Traits instead of the usual one and takes a full turn. Record your current Mental Traits on the item card at creation, in case it is later challenged with Reverse Conjuration. Retest with Occult.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
